messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://microfluidics.utoronto.ca/papers/d1lc01068a%20paper.pdf
Paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.1039/D1LC01068A

Protocol Details
ASSAY TYPE

Portable Sample Processing for Molecular Assays: Application to Zika Virus Diagnostics (Integrated Extraction, NASBA Amplification, and Cell-Free Toehold Switch Detection on Digital Microfluidics)

REAGENTS USED
Plasma Sample (human blood plasma containing Zika virus RNA)
Lysis Buffer
Proteinase K
Carrier RNA
Magnetic Beads (silica-coated paramagnetic particles for nucleic acid capture)
Wash Buffer
Ethanol Wash Buffer
Elution Water
NASBA Master Mix
NASBA Enzymes
Cell-Free (CF) Master Mix (cell-free protein expression system components)
Toehold Switch DNA (synthetic riboregulator circuit for Zika RNA detection)
STEPS
Lysis & Digestion: Mix the plasma sample with lysis buffer, heat at 95°C for 2 minutes, add Proteinase K and mix for 30 seconds, add carrier RNA and mix for 30 seconds, then incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Nucleic Acid Capture: Dispense and mix magnetic beads with the lysed sample for 5 minutes to bind viral RNA.
Primary Washes: Perform 4 successive wash cycles using wash buffer, mixing for 1 minute per wash followed by supernatant disposal.
Secondary Washes: Perform 2 successive wash cycles using ethanol wash buffer, mixing for 1 minute per wash followed by disposal.
Elution: Dispense elution water and mix with the captured beads for 3 minutes to recover purified RNA.
NASBA Amplification: Mix the RNA eluate with NASBA master mix, heat at 65°C for 2 minutes, cool to 41°C for 10 minutes, add NASBA enzymes, and incubate at 41°C for 90 minutes.
Cell-Free Detection: Mix cell-free master mix with toehold switch DNA for 30 seconds, combine with the NASBA amplification product, incubate at 37°C for 175 minutes, and detect fluorescence/colorimetric signal for 5 minutes.
Endpoint: Evaluate the Zika detection result against a threshold (≤ 50) to selectively dispose of the reaction mixture.
INTERPRETATION

Successful Zika virus detection is confirmed by robust target amplification through NASBA, followed by cell-free toehold switch expression of a reporter protein, producing a measurable fluorescent or colorimetric signal that indicates the presence of viral RNA in the plasma sample.

module fluorescence

manifest plasma_sample
manifest lysis_buffer
manifest proteinase_k
manifest carrier_rna
manifest magnetic_beads
manifest wash_buffer
manifest ethanol_wash_buffer
manifest elution_water
manifest nasba_master_mix
manifest nasba_enzymes
manifest cf_master_mix
manifest toehold_switch_dna

instructions:

// ---- Pre-processing (P): lysis and reversible RNA capture on magnetic beads ----
sample = dispense 5 units of plasma_sample
lysis = dispense 5 units of lysis_buffer
lysed = mix sample with lysis for 30s
heat lysed at 95c for 2m

pk = dispense 1 units of proteinase_k
lysed_pk = mix lysed with pk for 30s

carrier = dispense 1 units of carrier_rna
lysed_carrier = mix lysed_pk with carrier for 30s
heat lysed_carrier at 23c for 15m

beads = dispense 12 units of magnetic_beads
captured = mix lysed_carrier with beads for 5m

// ---- DMF Extraction (E_DMF): bead wash cycles (optimized to 6 washes) ----
repeat 4 times {
    wash = dispense 6 units of wash_buffer
    washed = mix captured with wash for 1m
    dispose wash
}

repeat 2 times {
    ewash = dispense 6 units of ethanol_wash_buffer
    ewashed = mix captured with ewash for 1m
    dispose ewash
}

eluent = dispense 5 units of elution_water
rna_eluate = mix captured with eluent for 3m

// ---- DMF Amplification (A_DMF): NASBA anneal, cool/equilibrate, amplify ----
mmix = dispense 3 units of nasba_master_mix
anneal_mix = mix rna_eluate with mmix
heat anneal_mix at 65c for 2m
heat anneal_mix at 41c for 10m

enzymes = dispense 1 units of nasba_enzymes
amp_mix = mix anneal_mix with enzymes
heat amp_mix at 41c for 90m

// ---- Cell-free protein expression assay (C): toehold switch colorimetric detection ----
cfmix = dispense 6 units of cf_master_mix
switch = dispense 1 units of toehold_switch_dna
cf_reaction = mix cfmix with switch for 30s

detection_mix = mix cf_reaction with amp_mix for 60s
heat detection_mix at 37c for 175m

zika_result = detect fluorescence on detection_mix for 5m

if (zika_result <= 50) {
    dispose detection_mix
}

dispose detection_mix

ir.content:
main:
	sample1[0] = dispense(plasma_sample)
	lysis1[0] = dispense(lysis_buffer)
	lysed1[0] = mix(sample1[0], lysis1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	heat(lysed1[0]) @ 95.0CELSIUS @ 120.0SECOND
	pk1[0] = dispense(proteinase_k)
	lysed_pk1[0] = mix(lysed1[0], pk1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	carrier1[0] = dispense(carrier_rna)
	lysed_carrier1[0] = mix(lysed_pk1[0], carrier1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	heat(lysed_carrier1[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 900.0SECOND
	beads1[0] = dispense(magnetic_beads)
	captured1[0] = mix(lysed_carrier1[0], beads1[0]) @ 300.0SECOND
bsbbr_2_h:
	PHI REPEAT_41 = {REPEAT_40,REPEAT_42}
	PHI washed1 = {washed0,washed2}
	PHI wash1 = {wash0,wash2}
	if REPEAT_41[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_3_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_4_f
bsbbr_3_t:
	wash2[0] = dispense(wash_buffer)
	washed2[0] = mix(captured1[0], wash2[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	dispose(wash2[0])
	REPEAT_42[0] = REPEAT_41[0] - 1
bsbbr_4_f:
bsbbr_5_h:
	PHI ewash1 = {ewash0,ewash2}
	PHI REPEAT_21 = {REPEAT_20,REPEAT_22}
	PHI ewashed1 = {ewashed0,ewashed2}
	if REPEAT_21[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_6_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_7_f
bsbbr_6_t:
	ewash2[0] = dispense(ethanol_wash_buffer)
	ewashed2[0] = mix(captured1[0], ewash2[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	dispose(ewash2[0])
	REPEAT_22[0] = REPEAT_21[0] - 1
bsbbr_7_f:
	eluent1[0] = dispense(elution_water)
	rna_eluate1[0] = mix(captured1[0], eluent1[0]) @ 180.0SECOND
	mmix1[0] = dispense(nasba_master_mix)
	anneal_mix1[0] = mix(rna_eluate1[0], mmix1[0])
	heat(anneal_mix1[0]) @ 65.0CELSIUS @ 120.0SECOND
	heat(anneal_mix1[0]) @ 41.0CELSIUS @ 600.0SECOND
	enzymes1[0] = dispense(nasba_enzymes)
	amp_mix1[0] = mix(anneal_mix1[0], enzymes1[0])
	heat(amp_mix1[0]) @ 41.0CELSIUS @ 5400.0SECOND
	cfmix1[0] = dispense(cf_master_mix)
	switch1[0] = dispense(toehold_switch_dna)
	cf_reaction1[0] = mix(cfmix1[0], switch1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	detection_mix1[0] = mix(cf_reaction1[0], amp_mix1[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	heat(detection_mix1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 10500.0SECOND
	zika_result1[0] = detect(fluorescence, detection_mix1[0]) @ 300.0SECOND
	if zika_result1[0] <= 50	|	true: jump bsbbif_8_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_9_f
bsbbif_8_t:
	dispose(detection_mix1[0])
bsbbif_9_f:
	PHI detection_mix2 = {detection_mix1,detection_mix}
	dispose(detection_mix2[0])
	NOP

metadata.notes: This protocol details Protocol Details. The assay is performed on a Digital Microfluidics (DMF) platform. The protocol enables reliable sample processing for nucleic acid amplification.
